core_categories: Pharmaceuticals; Veterinary Products; Homecare and Hospital-at-Home Medical Equipment; Parapharmaceuticals and Health Accessories; Continuing Education for Pharmacists
specialty_focus: CERP Rouen is a major French pharmaceutical wholesaler-distributor and subsidiary of the Astera Cooperative Group. It specializes in supplying independent community pharmacies with rapid, multiple-daily deliveries of human and veterinary medications, homecare medical equipment, and general health products. It operates within a pharmacist-owned cooperative framework, prioritizing member independence and secure logistics, and also provides continuing education programs for pharmacists.
